limits: Baseline and candidate use separate fresh HNSW indexes because symbol extraction version changes. Differences between variants can include construction and query-vector variation.
Each variant is replayed on its own same physical index to measure observed query stability. Replays do not establish equivalence between independent HNSW builds.
A managed server restart precedes each same-index replay. Persistent vectors/index identity are retained, but process state and index loading may contribute to observed repeat variation.
Sequential runs do not establish a latency speedup; p50, characters and model calls are reported separately.
Curated and previously exposed benchmark cases are development regression evidence, not untouched validation or downstream agent task-success evidence.
Model calls and tokens are observed administration counters. Missing provider usage or monitoring failures may skip observations; these are not definitive provider billing totals.

The baseline replay records 237 calls around short_queries and 42 around semantic_queries, while the semantic harness query window records 39. Three late background completions cross the suite boundary; per-suite surrounding admin windows must not be attributed exclusively to the named suite. The contiguous scored-phase total includes these boundaries.

One candidate ingestion batch returned HTTP 500 due to an external embedding connection failure. Normal prewarm resumed the same compatible fresh index through HTTP; this interruption is separate from scored query errors and can also affect the independent build trajectory.
